name: Mauro-Roman Kingdom
alt: Kingdom of the Moors and Romans

predecessors.name: Western Roman Empire
predecessors.text: much of Mauretania Caesariensis around Altava: 'Military independence from the Western Roman Empire: 429'

successors.name: Kingdom of Altava
successors.text: the rump state at Altava after Garmul's defeat and death in 578

ledger.x: 429: the Moors of Mauretania Caesariensis gain military independence from the Western Roman Empire (infobox 'Military independence from the Western Roman Empire: 429').
578: Garmul is defeated and killed and the kingdom shrinks to Altava.

wars.name: Massonas and the Eastern Romans against the Vandals
wars.outcome: 'Massonas allied with the Eastern Romans against the Vandals in 535 AD, according to Procopius.'

wars.name: Garmul's war on the Eastern Romans
wars.outcome: Garmul raided from the late 560s; generals Theodore and Theoctistus were killed in 570 and Amabilis in 571; the campaign against him ran 577-78 and he was killed in 578, after which the kingdom shrank to Altava.

certainty.note: A Moorish-Roman kingdom of the Algerian highlands: no page gives a frontier.
